historical_value_meaning: A3 acquire callback invoked once and incremented its counter before the transport pre-I/O policy guard

failure.precise_classification: TPEx transport policy rejected unreviewed market key before HTTP dispatch

evidence_basis: The sealed A3 runner passes TPEX to its acquire callback and increments live_counts before calling read_once.
The unchanged reviewed transport URLS and MARKET_SSL_POLICY use TPEx, not TPEX.
read_once calls policy_for_market before constructing or opening any HTTP request; policy_for_market raises ValueError(unreviewed_market) for TPEX.
The immutable outcome contains TWSE telemetry only and no TPEx HTTP telemetry.

post_live_test_disposition.reason: The test expects a candidate-drift guard but the persisted consumed latch correctly triggers the earlier single-use guard; no frozen A3 code or test was changed after consumption.
